title: Browse events listing and verify pagination controls are visible
description: Verifies a user can open the events listing page and see event results with pagination controls.

title: Search events by keyword and see matching results
description: Verifies keyword search filters the events list to relevant results.

steps.description: Verify element "Event results list" is visible

title: Filter events by type and verify filter is applied
description: Verifies selecting an event type filters the listing and updates the page state.

steps.description: Verify element "Event results list" is visible

title: Combine search + type filter and keep both filters active
description: Verifies combined filtering (search keyword and event type) works end-to-end.

steps.description: Verify element "Event results list" is visible

title: Pagination: move to next page of event results
description: Verifies a user can navigate to the next page of results and the URL/state updates.

steps.description: Verify element "Event results list" is visible

title: Pagination with filters: changing page keeps active filters
description: Verifies paginating does not drop an active search filter.

steps.description: Verify element "Event results list" is visible

title: Festival grouping: verify festival section/grouping is displayed when present
description: Verifies events grouped under a festival are displayed as a distinct group/section on the listing page.

steps.description: Verify element "Festival event group" is visible
Verify element "Event results list" is visible

title: Event detail page shows core event information and register CTA
description: Verifies a published event detail page displays the main sections (description, schedule/venue, prizes) and a visible registration call-to-action.

steps.description: Click on the first event card in the events list

title: Event detail page shows registration status as Open when registrations are available
description: Verifies the event detail page clearly shows an open registration status when registrations are enabled for the event.

steps.description: Click on an event that indicates registration is open

title: Event detail page shows registration status as Closed when registration window is over
description: Verifies the event detail page shows a closed status and does not present an active registration action when registrations are closed.

steps.description: Click on an event that indicates registration is closed

title: Event detail page displays capacity information when provided
description: Verifies that event capacity (total seats or remaining slots) is visible on the event detail page when the event is capacity-limited.

steps.description: Click on an event that shows a limited capacity indicator in the list

title: Event detail page handles missing optional sections gracefully (no prizes)
description: Verifies the event detail page renders without errors when optional fields like prizes are not present.

steps.description: Click on an event that does not mention prizes in its summary

title: Event detail page shows a not found message for an invalid/non-existent event link
description: Verifies the UI shows a user-friendly not found state when the event ID does not exist.

title: Event detail page shows a not found/restricted message for an unpublished or restricted event (student view)
description: Verifies the UI does not reveal details and shows a not found/restricted state when the event is not visible to students.

steps.description: Click on an event that appears restricted/unavailable (if present in the list) or a restricted event link provided by the environment

title: Register for a free event with required custom fields (happy path)
description: Verifies a logged-in student can complete registration for a free event by filling dynamic custom fields and seeing a success/QR confirmation.

steps.description: Click on an event card with a visible "Free" price label

title: Register for a free event with optional coupon field left empty
description: Verifies registration succeeds when the coupon code is not provided and only custom fields are filled.

steps.description: Click on an event card with a visible "Free" price label

title: Attempt registration with missing required custom field (client-side/server-side validation)
description: Verifies the registration form blocks submission or shows a visible validation error when required dynamic fields are not filled.

steps.description: Click on an event card with a visible "Free" price label

title: Apply an invalid coupon code and verify visible error message
description: Verifies an invalid coupon is rejected and the user sees a clear error without completing registration.

steps.description: Click on an event card with a visible "Free" price label
Type "INVALIDCOUPON123" into the coupon code field

title: Apply a valid coupon code and confirm discounted/free registration completes
description: Verifies a valid coupon can be applied and the user can complete registration successfully.

steps.description: Click on an event card with a visible "Free" price label
Type "VALIDCOUPON" into the coupon code field

title: Registration blocked when event is full (capacity reached)
description: Verifies the UI shows a clear error or disabled registration when an event has reached capacity.

steps.description: Click on an event card that shows a visible label such as "Full" or "Sold out"
Click on the "Register" button if it is visible
Verify text "Event is full" is visible

title: Login and open Team Registration page for an event
description: Verifies a student can log in and reach the team registration UI for an event.

steps.description: Click on an event card or event link that supports team registration

title: Create a new team successfully
description: Verifies a logged-in student can create a team for a team-based event and sees the new team in the UI.

steps.description: Click on an event card or event link that supports team registration
Type "Automation Team Alpha" into the team name field
Verify text "Automation Team Alpha" is visible

title: Prevent creating a team with an empty team name
description: Verifies the UI shows a validation message and does not create a team when team name is blank.

steps.description: Click on an event card or event link that supports team registration
Verify text "Team name is required" is visible

title: Payment page shows order details (amount and currency) before checkout
description: Verifies the payment page displays a clear payable amount and currency to the user before initiating checkout.

steps.description: Click on "My Registrations" (or "Registrations") in the main navigation
Click on a registration for a paid event that is awaiting payment

title: Prevent payment initiation when registration is missing or invalid (UI validation)
description: Verifies the UI blocks payment initiation or shows a clear error when required payment context is missing.

steps.description: Click on "My Registrations" (or "Registrations") in the main navigation
Click the "Pay" or "Payment" entry point for a registration that does not show a payable amount (free event or already paid)
Verify text "Payment not required" is visible
Verify element "Pay Now" is not visible

title: Already-paid registration does not allow starting a new Razorpay payment
description: Verifies the UI reflects completed payment and prevents duplicate payment attempts.

steps.description: Click on "My Registrations" (or "Registrations") in the main navigation
Click on a registration that is marked as paid/completed
Verify element "Pay Now" is not visible

title: Validate a percentage coupon during event registration and see discounted amount
description: Verifies a student can apply a valid percentage coupon during registration and the UI reflects the discount before completing registration.

steps.description: Click on "Events" in the main navigation
Click on an event card that shows a registration option

title: Authorized volunteer scans a valid QR for ENTRY and sees success details
description: Verifies that a user with QR scanning permission can record an ENTRY scan and see participant details and confirmation.

steps.description: Click on an event from the events list
Click on the "Scan" or "QR Scan" option for the event

title: Authorized volunteer scans a valid QR for EXIT and sees success details
description: Verifies that an authorized scanner can record an EXIT scan and see confirmation on the scan page.

steps.description: Click on an event from the events list
Click on the "Scan" or "QR Scan" option for the event
Select "EXIT" from the scan type dropdown

title: Scan ENTRY with gate and remarks recorded and visible in the success view
description: Verifies that optional metadata (gate and remarks) can be provided during scanning and is reflected in the visible scan confirmation.

steps.description: Click on an event from the events list
Click on the "Scan" or "QR Scan" option for the event
Type "Main Entrance" into the gate field
Type "on time" into the remarks field

title: Invalid QR code shows an error and does not show participant success details
description: Verifies that scanning an invalid/unrecognized QR displays a visible error state.

steps.description: Click on an event from the events list
Click on the "Scan" or "QR Scan" option for the event
Type "INVALID-QR-0000" into the QR code input field

title: User without scan permission is blocked from scanning (not authorized)
description: Verifies that a logged-in user lacking QR scan permission sees a visible 'not authorized' state when attempting to access scanning.

steps.description: Click on an event from the events list
Click on the "Scan" or "QR Scan" option for the event

title: Public certificate verification page loads and shows verification input
description: Verifies that the public certificate verification page is accessible and presents a way to enter a verification code.

title: Verify page rejects an obviously invalid verification code
description: Verifies that entering an invalid verification code shows a clear not-found/invalid result to the user.

title: Verify page handles empty submission gracefully
description: Verifies the verification form prevents or flags submission when the code is empty.

title: Verify page handles whitespace-only input as invalid
description: Verifies that whitespace-only input is not treated as a valid verification code.

title: My Certificates page is accessible after login
description: Verifies that a logged-in user can reach the My Certificates page and see the page content.

title: My Certificates page provides a way to verify a certificate
description: Verifies that the logged-in certificates area provides an obvious navigation path to certificate verification.

title: Organizer sends a bulk email successfully when sufficient credits are available
description: Verifies an organizer can compose and send a bulk email and sees a visible success confirmation with a sent count.

steps.description: Click on "Events" in the main navigation
Click on an event named "Email Credits Available"
Click on "Bulk Email" in the event menu
Type "Test subject - Bulk email" into the Subject field
Type "Hello, this is a test bulk email message." into the Email Body field
Select "All registrants" from the Recipient Filter dropdown

title: Bulk email send is blocked with visible error when credits are insufficient
description: Verifies the UI prevents sending bulk email and shows an 'Insufficient email credits' error when credits are not available.

steps.description: Click on "Events" in the main navigation
Click on an event named "No Email Credits"
Click on "Bulk Email" in the event menu
Type "Credits check" into the Subject field
Type "This should fail due to insufficient credits." into the Email Body field
Select "All registrants" from the Recipient Filter dropdown
Verify text "Insufficient email credits" is visible

title: Email history shows the most recent bulk email after a successful send
description: Verifies that after sending a bulk email, the email history page lists the new entry with a visible sent count.

steps.description: Click on "Events" in the main navigation
Click on an event named "Email Credits Available"
Click on "Bulk Email" in the event menu
Type "History entry check" into the Subject field
Type "This email should appear in history." into the Email Body field
Select "All registrants" from the Recipient Filter dropdown
Verify text "History entry check" is visible

title: Open analytics section is visible for an email history entry
description: Verifies the organizer can view open analytics for a sent email from the history screen.

steps.description: Click on "Events" in the main navigation
Click on an event named "Email Credits Available"
Click on the most recent email history row

title: Subject is required: sending with an empty subject shows a validation error
description: Verifies the bulk email form enforces required subject and displays a visible validation message.

steps.description: Click on "Events" in the main navigation
Click on an event named "Email Credits Available"
Click on "Bulk Email" in the event menu
Type "Body present but no subject." into the Email Body field
Select "All registrants" from the Recipient Filter dropdown
Verify text "Subject is required" is visible

title: Body is required: sending with an empty body shows a validation error
description: Verifies the bulk email form enforces required body and displays a visible validation message.

steps.description: Click on "Events" in the main navigation
Click on an event named "Email Credits Available"
Click on "Bulk Email" in the event menu
Type "Missing body validation" into the Subject field
Type " " into the Email Body field
Select "All registrants" from the Recipient Filter dropdown
Verify text "Body is required" is visible

title: Recipient filter must be selected: sending without a filter shows a validation error
description: Verifies the bulk email form enforces recipient filter selection before sending.

steps.description: Click on "Events" in the main navigation
Click on an event named "Email Credits Available"
Click on "Bulk Email" in the event menu
Type "Filter required" into the Subject field
Type "Attempting to send without choosing recipients." into the Email Body field
Verify text "Recipient filter is required" is visible

title: Email history list loads and displays key columns for an organizer
description: Verifies the email history screen loads successfully and shows expected visible headers/details for past emails.

steps.description: Click on "Events" in the main navigation
Click on an event named "Email Credits Available"

title: Organizer creates a new stall from an event’s Stalls page
description: Verifies an authenticated organizer can create a stall and sees it listed afterward.

steps.description: Click on an event item to open its details page
Click on "Stalls" (or "Stall Management") in the event navigation

title: Organizer submits the Create Stall form with valid details
description: Verifies the Create Stall form accepts valid inputs and shows the new stall in the list.

steps.description: Click on an event item to open its details page
Click on "Stalls" (or "Stall Management") in the event navigation
Type "Food & Beverages Stall" into the "Stall Name" field
Type "Snacks and beverages for attendees." into the "Description" field
Verify text "Food & Beverages Stall" is visible

title: Create Stall validation: required fields block submission
description: Verifies the UI prevents stall creation when required fields are empty and shows a visible validation message.

steps.description: Click on an event item to open its details page
Click on "Stalls" (or "Stall Management") in the event navigation

title: Public stall listing is visible from Stall Opportunities page
description: Verifies stall opportunities can be viewed in the public listing page UI.

steps.description: Verify element "Stall opportunities list" is visible

title: Public stall listing supports basic discovery/search interaction (if present)
description: Verifies users can filter or search stall opportunities and see updated visible results.

steps.description: Verify element "Stall opportunities list" is visible

title: Student attempts to apply when application portal is closed and sees an error
description: Verifies an authenticated student sees an 'Application portal closed' style error when applying during a closed window.

steps.description: Click "Stall Opportunities" in the main navigation (or open Stall Opportunities from Events)
Click on a stall opportunity item to open its details
Verify text "Application portal closed" is visible

title: Student application form blocks submission when mandatory fields are missing (if form exists)
description: Verifies the apply workflow shows visible validation feedback when the application form is incomplete.

steps.description: Click "Stall Opportunities" in the main navigation (or open Stall Opportunities from Events)
Click on a stall opportunity item to open its details

title: Organizer reviews stall applications list UI (visibility and basic loading)
description: Verifies the organizer can access the stall applications area and the list loads visibly.

steps.description: Click on an event item to open its details page
Click on "Stalls" (or "Stall Management") in the event navigation
Click on "Applications" (or "Student Applications") within Stall Management

title: Submit event feedback successfully with rating and optional comment
description: Verifies a public user can submit event feedback with a valid rating and comment and sees a success confirmation.

steps.description: Navigate to the event feedback page for a known event that the tester has attended (via a pre-seeded test event).
Type "Well organized event with helpful speakers." into the comment field.

title: Submit event feedback successfully with rating only (no comment)
description: Verifies a public user can submit event feedback with only a rating and the comment left blank.

steps.description: Navigate to the event feedback page for a known event that the tester has attended (use a different pre-seeded attendee identity or a separate pre-seeded event).

title: Validation error when submitting event feedback without rating
description: Verifies the UI blocks submission and shows a visible validation message when rating is missing.

steps.description: Navigate to the event feedback page for a known event that the tester has attended (pre-seeded test data).
Type "I forgot to rate but left a comment." into the comment field.

title: Prevent duplicate event feedback submission from the same user/session
description: Verifies the UI shows an error or disables resubmission after feedback was already submitted for the same event.

steps.description: Navigate to the event feedback page for a known event where feedback has already been submitted for this same tester identity/session (pre-seeded).

title: Feedback blocked when user has not attended the event
description: Verifies the UI prevents feedback submission and shows a visible error when the user did not attend the event.

steps.description: Navigate to the event feedback page for a known event that the tester has NOT attended (pre-seeded test data).

title: Submit stall feedback successfully with rating and comment
description: Verifies a public user can submit feedback for a stall with a valid rating and comment and sees a success confirmation.

steps.description: Navigate to the stall feedback page for a known stall within a known event that the tester has attended (pre-seeded test data).
Type "Great stall experience and quick service." into the comment field.

title: Rating boundary values accepted (1 and 10) for event feedback
description: Verifies the UI accepts minimum and maximum rating values without error and confirms submission.

steps.description: Navigate to the event feedback page for a known event that the tester has attended (pre-seeded test data that allows a fresh submission).
Navigate to the event feedback page for another known event that the tester has attended (pre-seeded test data that allows a fresh submission).

title: Organizer can view aggregated event feedback and responses list
description: Verifies an authenticated organizer can access the feedback results view and see aggregated values and a list of responses.

steps.description: Click on the event that has existing feedback (pre-seeded).
Click on "Feedback" (or "Feedback Results") in the event navigation.

title: Organizer logs in and opens the Event Management dashboard area
description: Verifies an organizer can log in and reach the event management dashboard entry point without errors.

title: Dashboard shows Registrations tab and loads registrations list
description: Verifies the organizer can open the Registrations tab and see a registrations list on the dashboard.

title: Registrations tab supports filtering using available filter controls
description: Verifies the registrations view exposes filter controls and applying a filter updates the visible list state.

title: Analytics tab loads and shows key metrics
description: Verifies the organizer can open Analytics and view key metrics like total registrations and attendance rate.

title: Analytics view shows a registrations-by-date visualization/section
description: Verifies Analytics includes a registrations-by-date section (chart/table) that renders visibly.

steps.description: Verify element "Registrations by date chart/table" is visible

title: Volunteers tab is accessible from the dashboard and renders its section
description: Verifies navigation to Volunteers tab works and the volunteers section is displayed.

title: Stalls tab is accessible from the dashboard and renders its section
description: Verifies navigation to Stalls tab works and the stalls section is displayed.

title: Feedback tab is accessible from the dashboard and renders its section
description: Verifies navigation to Feedback tab works and the feedback section is displayed.

title: Login fails with invalid credentials and prevents dashboard access
description: Verifies invalid login does not grant access to the event management dashboard and shows an error message.
